changes.note: `max_completion_tokens` also counts the reasoning tokens these models spend before they answer, so the same limit can leave a shorter answer, or an empty one when the limit is small. Raise it if answers come back cut off.

changes.quote: Starting with GPT-5.4, Chat Completions does not support tool calling with `reasoning_effort` values other than `none`.
changes.note: OpenAI's migration guide says that from GPT-5.4 on, Chat Completions calls tools only with `reasoning_effort: "none"`; otherwise the request fails with HTTP 400. The fix is either `reasoning_effort: "none"` (the model stops reasoning) or moving the request to the Responses API (the request and response are written differently). Both change how your code or the model behaves, so Refit leaves the choice to you.

Moving to `tools` and `tool_choice` also changes the response: calls come back in `message.tool_calls` with an ID each, not `message.function_call`, and each result goes back as a `tool` message with that ID. Code that reads the response has to change with the request, so Refit does not rewrite it.
